title: langgraph.errors.InvalidUpdateError: Invalid update for channel medical with values
observed_behavior: A loop graph writes the whole 'medical' dict from three nodes. After medical_mentor_pass, apply_writes receives two values for the non-reduced channel 'medical' in one super-step and raises InvalidUpdateError: Invalid update for channel medical with values [...]. Forcing the last value lets the graph run but it then loops between medical_mentor and medical_mentor_pass without reaching END.
structure_focus: Duplicate edges to the same target (plain edge plus conditional edge) plus a whole-dict state key with no reducer; loop exit ambiguity
notes: Closed as stale; comments report custom three-argument reducers that cannot work (reducers take two values). The topology registers medical_mentor -> medical_mentor_pass twice (add_edge and add_conditional_edges) while medical_mentor_pass also has a plain edge to END, and every node returns the complete medical dict. The double write and the non-terminating loop both follow from that state/edge design, so this is classified user_graph. The fixture keeps the duplicated edge and the dict-valued channel.
